problems.original_quote: remains, to the best of our knowledge, somewhat underexplored in the existing literature
problems.revised_quote: to the best of our knowledge, whether reviewer identity affects this relationship remains underexplored
problems.explanation: Dropping the hedge "somewhat" makes the research-gap claim stronger than the author stated.

problems.original_quote: The results of our analysis demonstrate that reviewer identity has a significant effect.
problems.revised_quote: Reviewer identity has a significant effect on the relationship between reviews and sales.
problems.explanation: The original does not say what reviewer identity affects; the revision specifies a moderating effect on the review-sales relationship, which the original never states, even though it matches the stated research question.

problems.original_quote: has fundamentally transformed the way in which consumers make purchasing decisions
problems.revised_quote: has transformed how consumers make purchasing decisions

problems.original_quote: we leverage a novel dataset comprising of 1.2 million reviews
problems.revised_quote: we use a dataset of 1.2 million reviews

problems.original_quote: this finding has important implications for platform design
problems.revised_quote: This finding has implications for platform design

parsed.summary: Most edits are filler removal and tightening, but the revision removes the hedge "somewhat" from the gap claim and specifies what reviewer identity affects, which the original left open. Several minor qualifiers ("fundamentally", "novel", "important") were also dropped.
